description: GEO-01A geo assertion and precision contract: design challenge and exact-diff review

approximate_as_exact.instructions: An approximate, external, disputed, hidden or unverified location could be stored or displayed as a verified entrance or an exact pin.

criteria.true: Some low-precision or unverified point can claim verified precision or render as an exact pin
criteria.false: Precision, verification and display rules prevent every such case

invalid_coordinates.instructions: A non-finite, out-of-range, swapped or wrong-SRID coordinate could be accepted.

criteria.false: All are rejected in code and database

provenance_optional.instructions: An assertion could be stored without its source, source reference, revision or observed time.

history_rewritable.instructions: A location assertion could be updated or deleted in place, or a supersession chain could fork or cross into another branch or tenant.

criteria.true: History can be rewritten or chains corrupted

tenant_or_patient_leak.instructions: A tenant could read or write another tenant's assertions, or patient location data could be stored or exposed.

criteria.true: Cross-tenant access or patient location is possible
criteria.false: RLS isolates tenants and only facility points exist

residual_risk.instructions: How much risk remains in this design?
